item.title: Version 0.5.0
item.description:
Added

  • Settings → Connections pane. New tab (⌘,) listing every app in your live org with Connect / Edit / Disconnect for RevenueCat, plus the Apple Ads account with masked credentials and Edit / Sign Out actions.
  • Guided RevenueCat connect flow. A step-by-step sheet walks you through creating a project-scoped Secret API key, lists the exact permissions RevenueCat needs, and includes a Test button that probes every endpoint and names the missing permission in plain English when something fails.
  • Post-Apple-Ads onboarding. After your first Apple Ads connect, a one-time sheet explains how RevenueCat adds revenue + attribution and links to the RevenueCat Apple Search Ads docs.
  • Apple Ads account chip in the sidebar. Click the status row to open a popover with the org name, masked Client ID, and Edit Credentials / Sign Out — credentials clear from Keychain but cached campaigns stay.

Changed

  • Sidebar collapses parallel RC syncs. When multiple apps are fetching, you get a single line (Fetching RC data for <App> and 3 other apps…) with a chevron to expand. Previously only the first fetch was visible.
  • RevenueCat auto-refreshes every 6 hours on launch. Apps with stale data queue a delta refresh automatically — no more “Synced 2 days ago”.
  • Removed the X customers · Y attributed line from the sidebar fetch status.

Fixed

  • Resumes interrupted RevenueCat syncs. Quit mid-sync and the next launch picks up from the saved cursor instead of starting over.
